How to read this

Prototype, not a final audit

  • The sample contains 100 commitments from each manifesto. It is curated rather than random, so the percentages describe this 200-point sample only.
  • Completed means the promised outcome was delivered at the stated or substantially equivalent scope. Partial means action occurred but the outcome, scale or wording changed. Not completed includes promises with no verified delivery by the cutoff.
  • AIADMK is assessed at the end of its 2016–2021 term. DMK is assessed at the end of its May 2021–April 2026 term. Each row links to its principal evidence; party or government claims remain labelled as such unless independently corroborated.
  • The next production step should cover every promise in both manifestos with two reviewers, archived primary documents, a dated change log and a public correction process.
